findings.claim: The diff adds frontend/src/components/videoapp/useRemovableItems.ts, a new module with JS-session-lifetime global state (operationsByKey, listenersByKey), and it is not in the declared touch-point list.
findings.impact: A second session-scoped store of removals sits next to discoverCache's removal set, and the touch points do not name it. Discover's drawn cards (keyed operations replayed over the supplied list) and the stored ids (discoverCache) can diverge without the plan accounting for it. The store also grows unbounded for the session. The module is also the path to F3.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/videoapp/useRemovableItems.ts (new file): module-level `operationsByKey` and `listenersByKey` Maps, never cleared (resetDiscoverCache does not clear them). Used by DiscoverFace.tsx (keyed by shelf.cacheKey) and VideoShelfPage.tsx (unkeyed). The touch points list discoverCache.ts, useDiscover.ts, DiscoverFace.tsx and VideoShelfPage.tsx, but not this module.

bucket_proposal.reason: An unplanned reach with new global state. On its own it breaks no declared invariant.

findings.proposed_fix: Add useRemovableItems.ts to the touch points. Either clear its keyed operations in resetDiscoverCache or document that the two stores are kept separately.

findings.claim: On the Recommended See all page, useRemovableItems is called without a key, so a removal made by one profile persists in local state across a profile switch that does not remount the page. It is replayed over the next profile's list and hides the same file there.
findings.impact: Viewer A marks file X on See all, then switches the profile to B without leaving the page. useProviderShelfPage refetches for B (nickname is in its deps), but the local 'remove X' operation is replayed, so X is missing from B's grid although B never marked it.
findings.evidence: VideoShelfPage.tsx: `const removable = useRemovableItems(provider.items);` (no key) and the grid renders `removable.items`. useRemovableItems.ts replays `localOperations` over any supplied list containing the id and never resets them. useProviderShelfPage.ts:165 includes `nickname` and `hasProfile` in the reload deps, so the list changes while the operations stay.
findings.repro: not_reproduced. Reasoned: render VideoShelfPage with nickname 'alice' and items [r1,r2,r3], remove r2, rerender with nickname 'bob' and a provider answer [r1,r2,r3]. Expected drawn [r1,r2,r3]; the code yields [r1,r3]. No test covers a profile switch on See all.

bucket_proposal.reason: One viewer's mark changes what another viewer is shown in the same drive (client-side). If 'served' is read as server-only, this falls to B.

findings.proposed_fix: Key useRemovableItems on the See all page by (drive, entry, nickname), or reset its local operations when nickname, drive or entry changes.

findings.claim: Changing `_indexed_drives` to include drives that only have marks also changes the drive set of `purge_disabled_vision_drives` and `purge_disabled_video_visual_drives`, which the touch points do not name.
findings.impact: On startup, mark-only drives now get extra vision_describe and video_visual_index policy lookups and run no-op purges, because those functions iterate IndexedFile rows and find none. A policy lookup error there is logged with logger.exception, so log noise is possible; no data is changed.
findings.evidence: addons/intelligence/app/purge.py:225 and :337 call `_indexed_drives()`, which now unions PickupNotInterested.drive_id (purge.py:188-210). The touch points name only `purge_drive`, `purge_disabled_drives` and `_indexed_drives`.

bucket_proposal.reason: An unplanned reach into two other startup purges. Their behavior is harmless and breaks no invariant.

findings.proposed_fix: Name the vision and video-visual purges in the touch points, or give purge_disabled_drives its own drive discovery that adds the mark drives.

findings.claim: ContextMenu gains a general `immediate` MenuItem flag, which bypasses the requestAnimationFrame deferral; the touch points describe the ContextMenu change only as a 'divider item'.
findings.impact: Any future caller that sets `immediate` gets synchronous onClick inside the click handler. Today only the new extra rows and the VideoCard menu use it, so callers that pass nothing are unchanged (I6 holds). It is unplanned API surface in the shared menu.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/ContextMenu.tsx: new `immediate?: boolean` on MenuItem, honored in onClick. Used in useFileMenuItems.ts (extra rows, `immediate: true`) and VideoCard.tsx (all menu rows).

bucket_proposal.reason: The file is in the touch points, but the new behavior is not.

findings.proposed_fix: Mention the `immediate` row option in the touch points for ContextMenu.
